content.title: Finding the Stronghold
content.body:
1. Right-Click an §oEye of Rahovart §rin your inventory.

    4. Once you find the Stronghold, find the §oPortal Room §rand §oplace your remaining Eyes of Rahovart §rin the sockets of every portal piece.
